note: Well-known protocol addresses. Presence per chain was verified with eth_getCode on 2026-10-09/10 for the initial relayer set (see Obsidian implementation-research). Always re-check with `up protocols verify` before value moves; `chains` lists where code was confirmed, absence elsewhere is unknown, not proof.

permit2.description: Uniswap Permit2 signature-based approvals (used by Uniswap and x402 exact-permit).

lsp26FollowerSystem.description: LSP26 Follower System registry (follow/unfollow, follower counts).

entryPointV06.description: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.6 (the version Extension4337 targets). The skill can deploy it deterministically via Nick's factory on request.

hyperlane.description: Hyperlane: LUKSO is a core chain (domain 42). Warp routes Ethereum <-> LUKSO for LYX and USDC. transferRemote(uint32 destination, bytes32 recipient, uint256 amount) payable; quoteGasPayment(uint32).

LYX.notes: native on LUKSO (msg.value = amount + gas quote), synthetic on Ethereum

USDC.notes: collateral on Ethereum (approve USDC first); synthetic on LUKSO is an LSP7 token (HypLSP7Pausable)

cowProtocol.description: CoW Protocol settlement. Contract accounts sign orders with setPreSignature(bytes orderUid, bool) on-chain (simplest for a UP via execute) or ERC-1271 off-chain.

uniswap.description: Uniswap: route via the Trading API or build Universal Router calls; not deployed on LUKSO. Universal Router addresses differ per chain — resolve from the official deployments page before use.

x402.description: x402 (HTTP 402 payments). exact-permit2 proxy; requires Permit2 (absent on LUKSO). A UP pays via ERC-1271 signatures where the facilitator supports smart-contract wallets.

across.description: Intent bridge aggregator (reference only; no LUKSO).

zeroEx.description: 0x Swap API v2 (supports smart-contract wallets via AllowanceHolder).

envioLukso.description: Envio GraphQL indexer for LUKSO mainnet (profiles, assets, holdings).

blockscout.description: Blockscout v2 REST on every chain whose explorer family is blockscout: /api/v2/addresses/{addr}/tokens, /token-transfers, /smart-contracts/{addr}.

alchemy.description: Alchemy Token/NFT APIs (API key; no LUKSO).

goldrush.description: GoldRush (Covalent) balances API (API key; no LUKSO).
